'''Max Lindsey''', better known by their{{Efn|Lindsey uses ''[[they/them]]'' pronouns. |name=pronouns|group=lower-alpha}} [[ring name]] '''Max the Impaler''', is an American [[professional wrestler]]. They are known for their tenure in the [[National Wrestling Alliance]] (NWA), where they are a former one-time [[NWA World Women's Television Championship|NWA World Women's Television Champion]] and a former one-time [[NWA World Television Champion]]. They also make appearances for [[Tokyo Joshi Pro-Wrestling]] (TJPW), where they have previously held the [[Princess Tag Team Championship]] and the [[International Princess Championship]].

== Professional wrestling career ==
===Early career (2018–2020)===
Max made their in-ring debut on December 15, 2018. They won the [[IWA Mid-South Women's Championship]] twice in the first half of 2019.<ref name="LastWord">{{Cite web|url=https://lastwordonsports.com/prowrestling/2020/02/25/indie-watch-max-the-impaler/|title=Indie Watch: Max The Impaler|first=Jamie|last=Greer|date=February 25, 2020|publisher=Last Word on Sports}}</ref> On February 22, 2020, Max appeared on the pre-show of [[Impact Wrestling]]'s [[Impact Wrestling Sacrifice (2020)|Sacrifice]], defeating Cali Young.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.facebook.com/permalink.php?story_fbid=2954629017938129&id=547204408680614&__xts__[0]=68.ARC4NDcNkMm_tVEi21_q051v7aX-wPp_G4sSB5X-hp5o1eyHZppg6BuqoVg4lRatink-EaxPBORw5owFhkNS_t4aSgIAw7xuDOcWTMO3kNNjJukk5gIkFyVYmXFJfmWiO_M6JYWU3VZrVz8aiQEGrx7SgMC-jtpgY3vT1-pX2xLBp48NSPMw3q7IUbE2kEPBo8y8fm-0nyvWHkVtNnjD2o8lms0zS8_of_DGOO-if_WBv28X_UbO49oWEg7jMTJ5LPlYRAQUaomGeiqFMQgzRtVO23044915F9zIXPes9iZMHJd3sYGefjJuz1V7mWS4Vi0P4pXJTVlqioE5QE4_lA&__tn__=-R|title=Impact Wrestling Sacrifice Results - February 22, 2020|website=www.facebook.com|language=en|access-date=2020-02-23}}</ref>

===Ring of Honor (2021)===
In August 2021, Max entered the [[ROH Women's World Championship]] tournament, defeating [[Holidead]] in the first round.<ref name="ROH14082021">{{Cite web|url=https://prowrestling.net/site/2021/08/18/roh-wrestling-tv-results-powells-review-of-champions-vs-all-stars-with-bandido-dragon-lee-jonathan-gresham-chris-dickinson-and-homicide-vs-jay-briscoe-mark-briscoe-ec3-flip-gordon-and-jos/|title=ROH Wrestling TV results: Powell's review of Champions vs. All-Stars with Bandido, Dragon Lee, Jonathan Gresham, Chris Dickinson, and Homicide vs. Jay Briscoe, Mark Briscoe, EC3, Flip Gordon, and Josh Woods, Holidead vs. Max The Impaler in an ROH Women's Championship tournament first round match|work=Pro Wrestling Dot Net|first=Jason|last=Powell|date=August 18, 2021|access-date=August 22, 2021}}</ref> In the following round, however, they lost to [[Angelina Love]] by disqualification.<ref name="ROH28082021">{{Cite web|url=https://prowrestling.net/site/2021/08/30/roh-wrestling-tv-results-powells-review-of-dragon-lee-vs-eli-isom-for-the-roh-tv-title-plus-angelina-love-vs-max-the-impaler-and-allysin-kay-vs-trish-adora-in-roh-womens-championship-tournam/|title=ROH Wrestling TV results: Powell's review of Dragon Lee vs. Eli Isom for the ROH TV Title, plus Angelina Love vs. Max The Impaler, and Allysin Kay vs. Trish Adora in ROH Women's Championship tournament quarterfinal matches|work=Pro Wrestling Dot Net|first=Jason|last=Powell|date=August 30, 2021|access-date=August 31, 2021}}</ref>

===National Wrestling Alliance (2022–present)===
Max made their [[National Wrestling Alliance]] (NWA) debut on the May 24, 2022 episode of ''[[NWA Powerrr]]'', defeating [[Ella Envy]].<ref>{{cite web | url=https://www.fightful.com/wrestling/results/nwa-powerrr-results-524-ella-envy-vs-max-impaler-trevor-murdoch-vs-mike-knox-headlines | title=NWA Powerrr Results (5/24): Ella Envy vs. Max The Impaler; Trevor Murdoch vs. Mike Knox Headlines|first=Robert|last=Defelice|publisher=Fightful|date=May 22, 2022|accessdate=April 2, 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220526021924/https://www.fightful.com/wrestling/results/nwa-powerrr-results-524-ella-envy-vs-max-impaler-trevor-murdoch-vs-mike-knox-headlines|archive-date=May 26, 2022}}</ref> On August 27, at night 1 of the [[NWA 74th Anniversary Show]], they won the [[gauntlet match|Burke Invitational gauntlet match]], which earned them the right to face [[Kamille (wrestler)|Kamille]] for NWA World Women's Championship match on night 2.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.facebook.com/permalink.php?story_fbid=pfbid03ihr7RtQouHvkJBRUckwCo46KZkSX8Sn9HupgFi3Jt7aAKCDXo2M1h7hY624S3C9l&id=547204408680614|title=NWA 74, Night 1 PPV Results - August 27, 2022|website=[[Facebook]] |date=August 27, 2022|access-date=August 28, 2022}}</ref><ref name="NWA74Night1">{{cite web|url=https://www.f4wonline.com/news/other-wrestling/nwa-74-night-one-live-results-matt-cardona-returns-four-title-matches|title=NWA 74 night one live results: Matt Cardona returns, four title matches|work=[[Wrestling Observer Newsletter]]|first=Josiah|last=MacDonald|date=August 27, 2022|access-date=December 28, 2022|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220920174113/https://www.f4wonline.com/news/other-wrestling/nwa-74-night-one-live-results-matt-cardona-returns-four-title-matches|archive-date=September 20, 2022|url-status=live}}</ref> However, Kamille successfully defended their title.<ref name="NWA74">{{cite web|first=Josiah|last=Macdonald|title=Five title matches, plus Nick Aldis vs. Flip Gordon, highlights the second night of action from St. Louis.|url=https://www.f4wonline.com/news/other-wrestling/nwa-74-night-two-live-results-trevor-murdoch-vs-tyrus-world-title-match|work=[[Wrestling Observer Newsletter]]|date=August 28, 2022|access-date=December 24, 2022}}</ref> On November 12, at [[NWA Hard Times 3]], Max defeated [[Natalia Markova]] in a [[casket match]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Ravens |first=Andrew |date=2022-11-12 |title=Card For Tonight's NWA Hard Times 3 PPV Event |url=https://wrestlingheadlines.com/card-for-tonights-nwa-hard-times-3-ppv-event/ |access-date=2022-11-19 |website=Wrestling Headlines |language=en-US|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230123170410/https://wrestlingheadlines.com/card-for-tonights-nwa-hard-times-3-ppv-event/|archive-date=January 23, 2023}}</ref>

On August 26, 2023, night one of the [[NWA 75th Anniversary Show]], Max defeated [[Kenzie Paige]] to win the [[NWA World Women's Television Championship]].<ref>{{cite web |last1=Tessier |first1=Colin |title=NWA 75 Night One Results (8/26/23): Kamille vs. Natalia Markova, Matt Cardona, More |url=https://www.wrestlezone.com/news/1398351-nwa-75-night-one-results-8-26-23-kamille-vs-natalia-markova-matt-cardona-more |website=Wrestlezone.com |date=August 26, 2023 |access-date=1 September 2023}}</ref> On night two, Max retained the title by successfully defending against Ruthie Jay.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Lowson |first1=Thomas |title=EC3 Wins NWA Worlds Championship - Forces Tyrus Into Retirement |url=https://www.msn.com/en-us/sports/more-sports/ec3-wins-nwa-worlds-championship-forces-tyrus-into-retirement/ar-AA1fSeM0 |website=msn.com |access-date=1 September 2023}}</ref> On the February 13, 2024 episode of ''Powerrr'', Max defeated Mims to win the [[NWA World Television Championship]], unifying the NWA men's and women's world television titles in the process.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.fightful.com/wrestling/max-impaler-defeats-mims-unifies-men-s-and-women-s-nwa-world-tv-titles-213-nwa-powerrr|title=Max The Impaler Defeats Mims, Unifies Men's And Women's NWA World TV Titles On 2/13 NWA Powerrr|first=Robert|last=Defelice|publisher=Fightful|date=February 13, 2024|accessdate=February 14, 2024}}</ref>

== Acting career ==
Max is featured in the horror film [[Dolly (2025 film)|Dolly]] as the titular creature.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Piepenburg |first1=Erik |title='Dolly' Review: Toy With Me |url=https://www.nytimes.com/2026/03/05/movies/dolly-review.html |website=The New York Times |access-date=6 March 2026}}</ref>
